concrete_increment: Accurate critical guidance can improve structural understanding while removing a defeasible route to checking a separate audience-response premise, changing the distribution of intellectual dependence. Draft must specify counterfactual disclosure comparison and distinguish sample loss from general inability to evaluate.
closest_overlap: Fischhoff (1975) already identifies changed salience and weakened hypothesis testing after outcome knowledge; Johnson already connects preserved ignorance with epistemic benefits and permits consent; Hazlett already allows understanding with dependence. None of accessed excerpts develops the precise explanation-induced redistribution of dependence across aesthetic premises.
limitations: Bounded English searches and primary excerpts, not universal priority proof. Critical pedagogy and reader-response coverage incomplete; Link and Levy not independently read. Hills supplemented with author-retained evidence; failed CMU/Oxford opens preserved.
